title: Calendar Free-Busy Overload Day
app: Obsidian Sync, Todoist, Toggl Track, Google Calendar / iCloud calendar exports, and task metadata ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=calendar:freebusy
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(busy_min) as busy_min by calendar _time
| where busy_min>480
| sort - busy_min
description: Uses Calendar free-busy exports telemetry to monitor days where scheduled busy time crossed a full workday in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for calendar overload before it feels normal, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Calendar free-busy exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Daily chart of busy minutes by calendar.
grandmaExplanation: It totals days where scheduled busy time crossed a full workday so you can spot calendar overload before it feels normal before it becomes annoying.
